senses.title: A move to a higher rank
senses.definition: a move to a higher position or rank at work
senses.definitionCN: 在工作上被移到更高的职位或级别
senses.example: She was given a promotion after the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 审计结束后她得到了晋升。
senses.why: Pro- 'forward' plus movere 'to move' gives 'a moving forward', and a career ladder is climbed one step at a time.
senses.whyCN: pro-「向前」加 movere「移动」构成「往前移」，而职业阶梯正是一步一步往上走的。

senses.title: A special offer to raise sales
senses.definition: a special offer, such as a discount or a gift, designed to raise sales quickly
senses.definitionCN: 以降价或赠品等方式在短期内快速拉动销量的特殊优惠
senses.example: The store ran a two-for-one promotion on coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店做了咖啡买一送一的促销。
senses.why: The same forward push is applied to goods: they are moved toward the buyer's hand rather than a person toward a higher desk.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「往前推」用在货物上：被推向顾客手边的是商品，而不是人被推向更高的职位。

senses.title: Publicity to make something accepted
senses.definition: organized publicity intended to make a product, event or idea accepted
senses.definitionCN: 为使产品、活动或理念被接受而组织起来的推广宣传
senses.example: The film's promotion included interviews in six cities.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的推广包括在六个城市做访谈。
senses.why: Moving a thing forward in public is the same verb, with reputation standing in for rank.
senses.whyCN: 在公众面前把某物往前推仍是同一个动词，只是「级别」换成了「名声」。

senses.title: Active support for a cause
senses.titleCN: 对某项事业的提倡与支持
senses.definition: active support for a cause, habit or practice
senses.definitionCN: 对某项事业、习惯或做法的积极支持
senses.example: The programme is a promotion of healthier eating in schools.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目是对校园健康饮食的提倡。
senses.why: To promote a cause is to push it forward until other people take it up.
senses.whyCN: 提倡一项事业，就是把它往前推，直到别人也接受它。

senses.title: The discounted item itself
senses.definition: in British usage, a product sold at a reduced price or offered as an inducement
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法中指降价出售或作为诱因提供的产品
senses.example: The supermarket's promotions were stacked by the entrance.
senses.exampleCN: 超市的促销品堆在入口旁。
senses.why: The abstract push turns concrete: the thing used to push sales takes the name of the push.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的「推」变具体了：被用来推动销量的那件东西，直接借用了「推」这个名字。

senses.title: The prospect of rising
senses.definition: the possibility of being moved to a higher rank, rather than the move itself
senses.definitionCN: 被提到更高职位的可能性，而不是那次调动本身
senses.example: There is little promotion in a flat organization.
senses.exampleCN: 在扁平的组织里几乎没有晋升机会。
senses.why: An uncountable reading names the prospect instead of the finished event.
senses.whyCN: 不可数的读法指的是「有这种可能」，而不是已经完成的那个事件。

senses.title: A team moving up a division
senses.definition: the movement of a sports team into a higher division
senses.definitionCN: 运动队被提升到更高一级联赛
senses.example: The club celebrated its promotion to the first division.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部庆祝球队升入甲级。
senses.why: A league is a ladder too, and a team climbs it by exactly the same forward step.
senses.whyCN: 联赛也是一把梯子，球队往上爬走的是完全同一个「向前一步」。

senses.title: Advancing a condition or process
senses.definition: the advancement of a condition or process, as in health promotion
senses.definitionCN: 推动某种状态或过程向前，如健康促进
senses.example: Health promotion focuses on prevention rather than treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 健康促进重在预防而不是治疗。
senses.why: What is pushed forward is now an abstract good, a state of health rather than a person or a product.
senses.whyCN: 这里被往前推的是一个抽象的好东西，是健康状况，而不是一个人或一件商品。

intro.en: Promotion is the noun of Latin promovere 'to move forward'. Rank came first, sales came much later.
intro.cn: promotion 是拉丁 promovere「向前移动」的名词形式。先有的是职位义，卖货义要晚得多。

items.en: Movere meant 'to move'. Its participle motus gives English motive and motion, and it works inside remove, emotion and commotion.
items.cn: movere 意为「移动」。它的分词 motus 给了英语 motive 与 motion，也藏在 remove、emotion、commotion 里。

items.en: Pro- 'forward, forth' plus movere produced promovere 'to move forward, to advance, to bring to notice'.
items.cn: pro-「向前、往外」加 movere 构成 promovere「向前移、推进、使被注意」。

items.en: The action noun promotio named the act of advancing. English took both the noun and the verb, the verb through French.
items.cn: 动作名词 promotio 指「推进」这个动作。英语把名词和动词都借了进来，动词是经法语来的。

items.en: The earliest English sense is advancement in rank or dignity, first in church and university usage.
items.cn: 英语最早的意思是职位或地位的提升，最初用于教会与大学。

items.en: American trade writing applied the word to efforts that push goods toward buyers, and sales promotion became a fixed term.
items.cn: 十九世纪的美国商业写作把这个词用于「把商品推向买家」的努力，sales promotion 成了固定说法。

items.en: The twentieth century added large-scale publicity and health promotion, and the word now covers any forward push.
items.cn: 二十世纪又添上了大规模宣传与健康促进，这个词如今涵盖任何向前的推动。

note.en: Group one shares the moving-forward root; group two names neighbouring commercial actions.
note.cn: 第一组共享「向前移动」的词根；第二组是相邻的商业动作。

entries.definition: The verb: to move someone or something forward. The noun adds -ion.
entries.definitionCN: 动词：把人或物往前推。名词多一个 -ion。

entries.definition: The person who pushes a project or a fight; a countable role, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 推动某个项目或赛事的人；是可数角色，不是动作本身。

entries.definition: The adjective describing material or offers used for promotion.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，描述用于推广的材料或优惠。

entries.definition: A headland, from mons 'mountain'; it looks like promotion but has no movere inside.
entries.definitionCN: 海角，出自 mons「山」；外形像 promotion，里面却没有 movere。

entries.definition: A single paid notice; promotion is the wider effort that may contain many notices and discounts.
entries.definitionCN: 单则付费告示；promotion 是更宽的努力，可包含许多告示与折扣。

entries.definition: Progress in rank or skill, usually without the commercial sense of selling goods.
entries.definitionCN: 职位或技能上的进步，通常不含推销商品的商业义。

entries.definition: A planned series of actions over a period; promotion can be a single offer or a whole strategy.
entries.definitionCN: 一段时期内计划好的一连串行动；promotion 可以只是单次优惠，也可以是一整套策略。

entries.definition: The attention gained, often unpaid; promotion is the deliberate effort to gain it.
entries.definitionCN: 获得的关注，往往不付费；promotion 则是刻意去争取这份关注的努力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin pieces and real derived words.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁语构件与真实的派生词。

normal.en: pro- 'forward' + mot- 'move': promotion is a move forward.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 mot-「移动」：promotion 就是一次向前移。

normal.en: The family runs promote, promotion, promoter, promotional.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 promote、promotion、promoter、promotional。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the senses: win a promotion, a sales promotion, health promotion.
normal.cn: 固定搭配把义项分开：获得晋升、促销活动、健康促进。

normal.en: The same mot- root sits in motion, motive, emotion and remove.
normal.cn: 同一个 mot- 词根还在 motion、motive、emotion 与 remove 里。

normal.en: A league table uses the word literally: promotion to a higher division.
normal.cn: 联赛积分榜把这个词用得很实在：升入更高一级。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on someone's back, pushing gently: that push is the whole word.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手放在某人背上轻轻往前推：这一推就是整个词的意思。

abstract.en: The push can act on a person (rank), a product (sales) or an idea (publicity).
abstract.cn: 这一推可以作用在人（级别）、作用于商品（销量）或作用于理念（宣传）。

abstract.en: Nothing moves by itself; promotion always needs a pushing hand.
abstract.cn: 没有东西会自己往前移；promotion 永远需要一只推动的手。

examples.en: He earned his promotion by rebuilding the entire accounts system.
examples.cn: 他靠重建整套账务系统赢得了晋升。

examples.en: The bookshop's winter promotion gives a free novel with every three bought.
examples.cn: 这家书店的冬季促销是买三本送一本小说。

examples.en: The agency handles promotion for the city's film festival.
examples.cn: 这家代理公司负责这座城市电影节的推广。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普若-摩申」——普若（向前）一摩，人就升上去了，货也推到手边 → promotion 晋升、促销

root: 拉丁 promovere「向前移动、推进」= pro-（向前）+ movere「移动」；动作名词 promotio。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses are one push forward: up a career ladder, toward a buyer's hand, into public acceptance, into a league above, or into a better condition.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都是同一个「往前推」：沿职业阶梯往上、推向顾客的手边、推进公众的接受、推进更高一级的联赛，或者推向更好的状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pushes something one step forward into the light.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把某物往前推一步，推进光里。

branches.en: LADDER: the finished move up and the mere prospect of it are the same step seen as event and as chance.
branches.cn: 阶梯：已经完成的上升与仅仅存在的上升可能，是同一步的「事件」与「机会」两面。

branches.en: GOODS: the offer pushes sales, and the discounted item takes the name of the push itself.
branches.cn: 货物：优惠动作推动销量，而被降价的那件东西直接借用了这个动作的名字。

branches.en: PUBLICITY: reputation is pushed forward instead of a person or a product.
branches.cn: 名声：被往前推的是声誉，而不是一个人或一件商品。

branches.en: CAUSE AND CONDITION: a practice or a state of health is pushed until others take it up.
branches.cn: 事业与状态：一种做法或一种健康状况被推到别人也接受为止。

branches.en: LEAGUE: a division table is a ladder in plain visible form.
branches.cn: 联赛：分级表就是一把看得见的梯子。

intro.en: Promotion is a Latin prefix, a Latin root and a Latin noun ending, all three of which build other English words.
intro.cn: promotion 由拉丁前缀、拉丁词根与拉丁名词词尾构成，三部分都还能构成别的英语词。

latinIntro.en: Promovere 'to move forward' is pro- plus movere; the same movere gives motion, motive, remove and emotion.
latinIntro.cn: promovere「向前移」是 pro- 加 movere；同一个 movere 还给了 motion、motive、remove 与 emotion。

items.example: The prefix gives the direction of the push.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀给出推动的方向。

items.example: Motion and motive share this root.
items.exampleCN: motion 与 motive 共享这个词根。

items.meaning: the act or result of an action
items.example: The suffix makes an action noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀造出动作名词。

items.meaning: the act or result of pushing forward
items.example: The promotion lifted sales by half.
items.exampleCN: 这次促销把销量提高了一半。

items.meaning: a reason that moves a person
items.example: Profit was not his only motive.
items.exampleCN: 利润并非他唯一的动机。

items.meaning: a feeling that moves one outward
items.exampleCN: 那场演讲激起了强烈情绪。

items.meaning: to move something back or away

definition_en: to officially leave a job, or to accept something you cannot change
core_image: 一个人把办公室钥匙放在桌上，签下最后一笔
scene: 董事会改组后，财务总监当天就递交了辞呈。 After the board was reshuffled, the finance director resigned that same day.
sceneCN: 这里 resign 是「辞职」（第 1 个义项：正式离开职位）；句意：董事会改组后，财务总监当天就辞职了。

senses.title: To leave a job officially
senses.definition: to state formally that you are leaving your job or position
senses.definitionCN: 正式声明将要离开工作或职位
senses.example: The finance director resigned that same day.
senses.exampleCN: 财务总监当天就辞职了。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to unseal or give back, and giving back a post is the modern core.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为开封交回，而把职位交回就是现代核心义。

senses.title: To give up a right or claim
senses.definition: to surrender a right, claim, or possession formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式让出权利、主张或所有物
senses.example: She resigned her claim to the property.
senses.exampleCN: 她放弃了对这处房产的继承主张。
senses.why: What is given back can be a right as well as a job.
senses.whyCN: 交回的既可以是职位，也可以是权利。

senses.title: To accept what cannot be changed
senses.definition: to accept an unpleasant situation because it cannot be avoided
senses.definitionCN: 因无法避免而接受不愉快的处境
senses.example: He resigned himself to another long wait.
senses.exampleCN: 他只好认命，再等下去。
senses.why: Giving up resistance inward produces the reflexive sense of resigning oneself.
senses.whyCN: 在内心里放弃抵抗，就产生「使自己顺从」的反身义项。

intro.en: Resign comes from Latin resignare, to unseal or cancel, from re- and signare, to mark with a sign.
intro.cn: resign 来自拉丁语 resignare（开封、注销），由 re- 与 signare（作标记）构成。

items.en: Signare means to mark or seal.
items.cn: signare 意为标记或盖章。

items.en: Resignare means to unseal or cancel a document.
items.cn: resignare 意为开封或注销文书。

items.en: Resigner means to resign or give up.
items.cn: resigner 意为辞去、放弃。

items.en: Middle English resignen means to give up a claim.
items.cn: 中古英语 resignen 意为放弃主张。

items.en: Resign is used for leaving an office.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，resign 用于离开职位。

items.en: Modern English extends resign to accepting what cannot be changed.
items.cn: 现代英语把 resign 扩展到接受无法改变之事。

note.en: Resign is a handing-back verb, and it sits near its family and near verbs for quitting and surrendering.
note.cn: resign 是一个「交回」动词，与自身词族以及表示退出和让出的动词相邻。

entries.definition: the act or letter of leaving a job
entries.definitionCN: 辞职；辞呈

entries.definition: accepting something unwillingly
entries.definitionCN: 顺从的；无奈的

entries.definition: in a patient, accepting way
entries.definitionCN: 无奈地；顺从地

entries.definition: to leave a job, informal
entries.definitionCN: 辞职（口语）

entries.definition: to go away from a job or place
entries.definitionCN: 离开

entries.definition: to give up something after resistance
entries.definitionCN: 放弃；投降

normalIntro.en: Resign is re- plus sign: to sign a name back, as if returning the post.
normalIntro.cn: resign 是 re- 加 sign：把名字签回去，好像把职位交还。

normal.en: The Latin verb means to unseal or cancel, which becomes giving up a claim.
normal.cn: 拉丁动词意为开封或注销，后来变成放弃主张。

normal.en: Resign from a job is the usual pattern.
normal.cn: resign from a job 是常见搭配。

normal.en: Resign oneself to something means accept it unwillingly.
normal.cn: resign oneself to something 意为不情愿地接受。

normal.en: Resignation is both the act and the letter.
normal.cn: resignation 既指辞职行为，也指辞呈。

normal.en: Compare quit: quit is informal, while resign is official.
normal.cn: 对比 quit：quit 口语化，resign 更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a key placed on a desk beside a signed letter.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙放在桌上，旁边是一封签好的信。

abstract.en: Imagine a name being crossed off a door.
abstract.cn: 想象门上的名字被划掉。

abstract.en: Think of a knot loosened rather than cut.
abstract.cn: 想象绳结被慢慢松开，而不是剪断。

examples.en: The finance director resigned that same day.
examples.cn: 财务总监当天就辞职了。

examples.en: She resigned her claim to the property.
examples.cn: 她放弃了对这处房产的继承主张。

examples.en: He resigned himself to another long wait.
examples.cn: 他只好认命，再等下去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + sign」——再次签字，把职位交回，就是辞职；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 signare（标记）→ resignare（开封、注销）→ 古法语 resigner → 中古英语 resignen → 现代英语 resign。

sensesIntro.en: The verb starts with formally handing something back, applies it to jobs and claims, and finally turns inward to accepting what cannot be changed.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从正式交回某物开始，用于职位与主张，最后转向内心，表示接受无法改变之事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key and a signed paper left on a desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙与签好的文件留在桌上。

branches.en: Leaving a post is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 离开职位，是现代主要义项。

branches.en: Giving up a right is the same handover in law.
branches.cn: 放弃权利，是法律中的同一种交回。

branches.en: Accepting the unavoidable is a handover inside the mind.
branches.cn: 接受不可避免之事，是内心里的交回。

branches.en: A post and a claim can both be formally given back.
branches.cn: 职位与主张都可以正式交回。

branches.en: Giving up a claim and giving up struggle lead to the same quiet.
branches.cn: 放弃主张与放弃挣扎通向同一种平静。

intro.en: Resign is a Latin verb carried through French, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: resign 是经法语传递的拉丁动词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin signare means to mark or seal, and resignare means to unseal or cancel.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 signare 意为标记或盖章，resignare 意为开封或注销。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of giving back.
Resignare joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: resignare 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Resigner carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: resigner 把这个动词带入法语。

items.meaning: the act or letter of resigning

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的词尾

definition_en: a person sent to speak for a group; also to give a task or power to someone else
core_image: 一个人举起写着团体名字的牌子
scene: 会议开始前，每个人在门口的册子上写下自己的名字和所代表的城市。 Each delegate signed the book at the door.
sceneCN: 这里 delegate 指「代表」（第 1 个义项：替团体出席的人）；句意是每位代表都在门口册子上签了名。

senses.title: A person who speaks for a group
senses.definition: someone chosen to attend a meeting and act for a larger group
senses.definitionCN: 被选去参加会议并代表较大团体行事的人
senses.example: Each delegate signed the book at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 每位代表都在门口册子上签了名。
senses.why: A crowd cannot all stand at one table, so it sends one pair of hands.
senses.whyCN: 一群人没法都坐到同一张桌前，只好派出一双手。

senses.title: Hand a task to someone
senses.definition: to give part of one's work to another person to do
senses.definitionCN: 把自己的一部分工作交给别人去做
senses.example: A good manager delegates the small tasks.
senses.exampleCN: 好的管理者会把小事分派出去。
senses.why: Two hands can hold more than one pair can.
senses.whyCN: 两双手能拿的东西，比一双手多。

senses.title: Give power to another
senses.definition: to give someone the right to act or decide in your place
senses.definitionCN: 授予他人代替你行事或决定的权力
senses.example: The board delegated full power to the new director.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会把全部权力授予了新主管。
senses.why: Trust is a key that changes hands without changing locks.
senses.whyCN: 信任是一把换了手、却没换锁的钥匙。

intro.en: Delegate comes from Latin delegare, to send with a charge, from de- away and legare to send.
intro.cn: delegate 来自拉丁语 delegare（派人带任务去），由 de-（离开）与 legare（派遣）组成。

items.en: Legare meant to send a person with a duty.
items.cn: legare 意为派一个人带着任务去。

items.en: Delegare added the idea of handing the charge over.
items.cn: delegare 又多了一层「把任务交出去」的意思。

items.en: English used delegate as a noun for a sent person.
items.cn: 英语先把 delegate 作名词，指被派出去的人。

items.en: The verb grew, meaning to entrust work or power.
items.cn: 动词用法长出来，指托付工作或权力。

items.en: Managers now delegate tasks as easily as states send delegates.
items.cn: 如今管理者分派任务，就像国家派出代表一样自然。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the leg stem, and the meaning group names the person who stands in for others.
note.cn: 形近组共用 leg 词干，近义组则是几个「替别人出面」的人。

entries.definition: a group sent to speak for others
entries.definitionCN: 被派去代表他人发言的一群人

entries.definition: done on purpose and after thought
entries.definitionCN: 有意的、经过考虑的

entries.definition: an official messenger of high rank
entries.definitionCN: 高级别的官方使节

entries.definition: a person chosen to act for a group
entries.definitionCN: 被选来代表团体行事的人

entries.definition: a person who acts for a leader
entries.definitionCN: 代替领导者行事的人

entries.definition: a person sent to carry a message
entries.definitionCN: 被派去传达消息的人

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a name written at a meeting door and end with a key handed to someone you trust.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从会议门口写下的名字开始，落到交到信任之人手里的钥匙。

normal.en: One person at the table can carry a whole town in a folder.
normal.cn: 桌边一个人，文件夹里能装下一整座城。

normal.en: A manager who keeps every task ends up holding nothing well.
normal.cn: 什么活都攥在手里的管理者，最后什么也拿不稳。

normal.en: To delegate is to lend your signature for a while.
normal.cn: 授权，就是把自己的签名借出去一阵。

normal.en: A delegate is a voice sent away from home.
normal.cn: 代表，是从家里被派出去的一个声音。

normal.en: Legare means to send, so a delegate is one who was sent.
normal.cn: legare 是派遣，所以代表就是被派出去的人。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised with a card bearing a town's name.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手举起来，牌子上写着一座城的名字。

abstract.en: Picture a pile of papers moving from one desk to another.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠纸从一张桌子移到另一张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a key pressed into a palm and the fingers closing.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙按进掌心，手指合拢。

examples.en: Each delegate signed the book at the door.
examples.cn: 每位代表都在门口册子上签了名。

examples.en: A good manager delegates the small tasks.
examples.cn: 好的管理者会把小事分派出去。

examples.en: The board delegated full power to the new director.
examples.cn: 董事会把全部权力授予了新主管。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 delegate 记成「得力干将」：de 开头，legate 是派出去的人，派出去的总是得力的那位。

root: 源自拉丁语 delegare，由 de-（离开）与 legare（派遣）合成，本义是派人带着任务出去。英语先把它作名词表示使者与代表，十六世纪又生出动词义，指把工作或权力托付给别人。

sensesIntro.en: From a person sent to a meeting, to a task handed over, to the right to decide in your place.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被派去开会的人，到交出去的一项工作，再到代你决定的权力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one pair of hands holding a card for many people.
core.cn: 核心意象：一双手替许多人举着一块牌子。

branches.en: The first sense is the chosen person who speaks for the rest.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是被选中替众人说话的人。

branches.en: The second sense is work passed to another pair of hands.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把工作交到另一双手里。

branches.en: The third sense lends the right to decide, not only the work.
branches.cn: 第三个义项借出的是决定权，不只是活儿。

branches.en: A representative and a handed task are both things sent outward.
branches.cn: 代表与被交出的任务，都是被送出去的东西。

branches.en: Both senses trust another person with a part of your own role.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是把自己角色的一部分托付给别人。

intro.en: Delegate brings nouns of groups and of the act of handing power over.
intro.cn: delegate 带来表示团体和授权行为的名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is legare, to send, with de- meaning away.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 legare（派遣），前缀 de- 表示离开。

items.example: One delegate spoke for the village.

items.meaning: a group sent, or the act of entrusting
items.example: A small delegation met the mayor.
items.exampleCN: 一个小代表团见了市长。

items.example: The delegated work was finished early.
items.exampleCN: 分派出去的工作提前完成了。

items.meaning: the one who hands work over
items.example: The delegator keeps the final say.
items.exampleCN: 委派者保留最后决定权。

items.meaning: able to be handed to another
items.exampleCN: 并非每项职责都能交出去。

items.meaning: a person sent to discuss trade
items.example: The trade delegate met the exporters.
items.exampleCN: 贸易代表会见了出口商。
好的领导者会下放权力。

items.meaning: a person attending a conference for a group
items.example: Every conference delegate got a badge.
items.exampleCN: 每位会议代表都领到了胸牌。

definition_zh: 监督；管理；指导；看管（工作、活动或人）
definition_en: to watch over people or work and make sure it is done properly
core_image: 一个人站在高处的平台边，低头看着下面每一道工序
scene: 实验室新来的学生要做一组危险反应，导师没有替他动手，只站在旁边看每一步，出错就叫停。 A senior researcher supervises every first attempt in the fume hood.
sceneCN: 这里 supervise 指在旁边看管、确保别人把事做对（第 1 个义项：监督他人的工作）；句意：一位资深研究员在通风柜旁监督每一次初次操作。图中可辨识物件：通风柜、实验记录、护目镜、警示标牌。

senses.title: Watch over other people's work
senses.definition: to watch workers and check that their work is done correctly
senses.definitionCN: 看住正在做事的人，核查其工作是否正确完成
senses.example: A foreman supervises the welding on the upper deck.
senses.exampleCN: 一名工头在上层甲板上监督焊接。
senses.why: Super- means over and videre means to see, so the word is literally looking down on the work.
senses.whyCN: super 意为「在上」，videre 意为「看」，因此这个词字面上就是从上方看着工作。

senses.title: Be in charge of a whole activity
senses.definition: to be the person responsible for an activity or a place and how it is run
senses.definitionCN: 对一项活动或一个场所及其运作负总责
senses.example: She supervises the whole summer programme at the camp.
senses.exampleCN: 她负责夏令营整个暑期项目的监管。
senses.why: Responsibility grows out of looking: whoever watches over everything must answer for it.
senses.whyCN: 责任由「看」长出来：看住全局的人，就得为全局负责。

senses.title: Invigilate an examination
senses.definition: to watch candidates during an examination so that the rules are kept
senses.definitionCN: 考试期间看住考生，使规则得到遵守
senses.example: Two teachers supervise the hall during the written paper.
senses.exampleCN: 笔试期间有两位老师在考场监考。
senses.why: An exam is a small closed world, and someone must stand above it and see that nothing passes unseen.
senses.whyCN: 考场是一个封闭的小世界，必须有人站在高处看着，不让任何事在无人察觉中发生。

senses.title: Guide a research student
senses.titleCN: 指导一名研究生的论文
senses.definition: to advise a student and check the progress of their research over months
senses.definitionCN: 在数月间指导学生并检查其研究进展
senses.example: He supervises three doctoral students in the same lab.
senses.exampleCN: 他在同一个实验室指导三名博士生。
senses.why: Research is slow work with no visible product, so its supervision is periodic looking rather than standing guard.
senses.whyCN: 研究是缓慢且没有可见产出的工作，因此对它的「看」是定期巡视，而不是站岗。

senses.title: Oversee a building site
senses.definition: to watch a construction site to ensure the work matches the drawings and the safety rules
senses.definitionCN: 在施工现场看管，确保施工符合图纸与安全规定
senses.example: An engineer supervises the pouring of the foundation.
senses.exampleCN: 一位工程师监督地基浇筑。
senses.why: On a site the drawing is the truth, and the supervisor's eye compares stone with paper.
senses.whyCN: 在工地上，图纸就是准绳，监督者的眼睛把石头与纸上的线对照起来。

senses.title: Monitor a process or machine
senses.titleCN: 监视流程或设备的运行
senses.definition: to keep a continuous check on a machine or process, often through instruments
senses.definitionCN: 对机器或流程作持续检查，常借助仪表
senses.example: Software supervises the temperature of the kiln all night.
senses.exampleCN: 软件整夜监视窑炉的温度。
senses.why: When no person can stand beside the machine, instruments take over the looking.
senses.whyCN: 没人能整夜守在机器旁时，仪表就替人承担了「看」。

senses.title: Keep watch over people for safety
senses.titleCN: 为安全看管儿童或病人
senses.definition: to stay with children or patients in order to prevent harm
senses.definitionCN: 陪伴儿童或病人，以防他们受到伤害
senses.example: Two adults supervise the children in the shallow end.
senses.exampleCN: 两位成年人在浅水区看管孩子。
senses.why: Here the object watched is a person rather than a task, and the eye is guarding, not judging.
senses.whyCN: 这里被看的是人而不是活，眼睛起的是守护作用，而不是评判。

senses.title: Check work remotely through reports
senses.titleCN: 通过报告远程核查工作
senses.definition: to direct work from a distance by reading reports and approving results
senses.definitionCN: 通过阅读报告与批准结果，在远处指挥工作
senses.example: The regional office supervises twelve branches by monthly report.
senses.exampleCN: 区域办事处靠月度报告监管十二家分店。
senses.why: Looking over need not mean standing next to; a report is the eye at a distance.
senses.whyCN: 「在上方看」不必站到旁边；一份报告就是远处的眼睛。

intro.en: Supervise comes from Medieval Latin supervisus, the past participle of supervidere 'to look over', built on super 'over' and videre 'to see'. The English verb entered through the same learned channel as survey.
intro.cn: supervise 来自中世纪拉丁 supervisus，即 supervidere「从上方看」的过去分词，由 super「在上」与 videre「看」构成。这个英语动词与 survey 经由同一条学术渠道进入英语。

items.en: Videre meant 'to see'. Its perfect stem vis- supplies the vis- inside supervise, supervision and vision.
items.cn: videre 意为「看见」。它的完成时词干 vis- 提供了 supervise、supervision 与 vision 里的 vis-。

items.en: Super meant 'above, over'. It is the same prefix that gives superstructure and superimpose, and it keeps the picture of a higher eye.
items.cn: super 意为「在上、越过」。它与「上部结构」「叠加」两个词用的是同一个前缀，保留「更高处的一只眼」的画面。

items.en: Supervidere 'to look over, inspect' produced the participle supervisus, which became the source of the English verb and noun.
items.cn: supervidere「巡视、检查」产生分词 supervisus，后者成为英语动词与名词的来源。

items.en: Supervise is recorded in English from the fifteenth century in the sense of inspecting or having charge of work; the date is approximate.
items.cn: supervise 在十五世纪见于英语记录，意为检查或掌管工作；年代为约数。

items.en: Survey came through Old French surveeir from the same Latin verb, so the two English words are cousins rather than strangers.
items.cn: survey 经古法语 surveeir 来自同一个拉丁动词，因此这两个英语词是表亲而非陌路。

items.en: The academic, construction and machine senses are nineteenth- and twentieth-century specialisations of the same act of looking over.
items.cn: 学术、施工与机器方面的义项，是同一个「巡视」动作在十九、二十世纪的专业化。

note.en: The first group shares the vis- root or a near shape; the second group holds verbs of watching and checking.
note.cn: 第一组共享 vis- 词根或形音相近；第二组是表示看管与核查的动词。

entries.definition: The noun of the activity, not the act performed on a particular day.
entries.definitionCN: 指这项活动的名词，不是某一天的具体动作。

entries.definition: The person who does the watching.
entries.definitionCN: 负责看管的那个人。

entries.definition: From the same Latin verb, but it means to examine a whole area or to ask a sample of people.
entries.definitionCN: 同出那个拉丁动词，但指勘察整片区域或调查一批人。

entries.definition: Built on super plus venire 'to come', so it means to come on top of something, not to watch it.
entries.definitionCN: 由 super 加 venire「来」构成，意为随后附加而来，不是看管。

entries.definition: The English twin of supervise, slightly more general and often used of projects.
entries.definitionCN: supervise 的英语对应词，含义稍泛，常用于项目。

entries.definition: Watch continuously, usually by instrument, without necessarily having authority.
entries.definitionCN: 持续观察，通常借助仪表，未必拥有管辖权。

entries.definition: A formal word for being in charge of an operation from above.
entries.definitionCN: 较正式的「在上面掌管一项运作」的说法。

entries.definition: The narrow British verb for watching an examination.
entries.definitionCN: 英式英语中专门指监考的动词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the two real Latin pieces and the real word family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用两个真实的拉丁构件与真实的同族词。

normal.en: Super is over and videre is to see, so supervise is to see over the work.
normal.cn: super 是「在上」，videre 是「看」，supervise 就是在上面看着工作。

normal.en: The family runs supervise, supervision, supervisor and supervisory.
normal.cn: 同族词有 supervision、supervisor、supervisory 与 supervisorship。

normal.en: Real objects of the verb are work, staff, an exam, a thesis and a site.
normal.cn: 这个动词的真实宾语是工作、员工、考试、论文与工地。

normal.en: Vision belongs to the same root, because watching and seeing are one act.
normal.cn: vision 同出这个词根，因为看管与看见本是一个动作。

normal.en: Survey is a cousin: it looks over a whole area rather than over people.
normal.cn: survey 是表亲：它巡视的是一整片区域，而不是人。

abstract.en: Picture an eye at the top of a shaft, following a bucket all the way down.
abstract.cn: 想象竖井顶端的一只眼，跟着吊桶一路下到底。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that corrects a line only after the pen has stopped.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手只在笔停下之后才去改那一行。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp that moves along the bench, always lighting the next cut.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯沿工作台移动，总照着下一刀。

examples.en: A nurse supervises the trainees during their first injection.
examples.cn: 护士在实习生第一次注射时在旁监督。

examples.en: The committee was set up to supervise the spending of the grant.
examples.cn: 这个委员会是为监督这笔拨款的使用而设的。

examples.en: No one supervised the loading, and two crates were crushed.
examples.cn: 装车时没人监管，两只板条箱被压坏了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「super（在上）+ vise（看）」——站在上面看，就是监督

root: 中世纪拉丁 supervisus（supervidere 的过去分词）= super「在上」+ videre「看见」；同根词有 supervision、supervisor、vision，survey 亦同出一源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep one eye above the work: it watches a crew, takes charge of a programme, guards an exam, follows a student for months, compares a site with its drawings, reads instruments, watches children and reads distant reports.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保持「一只眼在工作上方」：看住工班、负责一个项目、守住考场、跟上学生数月、把工地与图纸对照、读仪表、看住孩子，以及读远方送来的报告。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an eye above the work, following each step without touching it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只眼在工作上方，跟着每一步，却不伸手。

branches.en: THE CREW AND THE PROGRAMME: watching hands, and answering for everything.
branches.cn: 工班与项目：看着一双手，也为全局负责。

branches.en: THE CLOSED ROOM: an examination is watched so nothing passes unseen.
branches.cn: 封闭的房间：考场被看着，不让任何事漏过。

branches.en: SLOW WORK AND HARD STONE: months of research, and drawings checked against concrete.
branches.cn: 慢工与硬石：数月的研究，以及把图纸与混凝土对照。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENT'S EYE: when no person can stay, a gauge does the looking.
branches.cn: 仪表之眼：没人守得住时，由表盘来看。

branches.en: FROM GUARDING TO REPORTING: watching a child for safety, and reading a branch's monthly sheet.
branches.cn: 从守护到汇报：为安全看着孩子，以及读分店的月报。

intro.en: Supervise is a Latin preposition plus a seeing root, and the same two pieces build a number of English words.
intro.cn: supervise 是一个拉丁介词加上一个「看见」词根，同样的两个构件还构成若干英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin super gives supervise, superstructure and superimpose; Latin videre gives vision, visual and evident.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 super 衍生 supervise（监督）、superstructure（上部结构）与 superimpose（叠加）；拉丁 videre 衍生 vision（视觉）、visual（视觉的）与 evident（明显的）。

items.example: The prefix places the eye higher than the work.
items.exampleCN: 前缀把眼睛放在比工作更高的位置。
这个词根提供「看」这个动作。

items.example: The compound is the direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: The verb keeps the plain act of looking over.
items.exampleCN: 动词保留「在上方看」的直白动作。

items.example: The noun names the activity rather than one occasion.
items.exampleCN: 名词指这项活动，而非某一次。

items.example: The agent noun names the eye.
The cousin looks over land, not people.
items.exampleCN: 这位表亲巡视的是土地，不是人。

items.example: The root also names seeing itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也命名「看」本身。

definition_zh: 推迟；延期；暂缓；把……置于次要地位；使延缓发生
definition_en: to move an event or decision to a later time, to keep something from happening yet, or to place one thing after another in order or importance
core_image: 行李箱上的日期签被撕下，重新贴上一张更晚的日子
scene: 赛前一夜下起大雨，球场边的排水沟满得往外溢，裁判举着喇叭跟两队教练商量。 The referee decided to postpone the match until the following weekend.
sceneCN: 这里 postpone 指「把比赛改到更晚的时间」（第 1 个义项：活动延期举行）；句意为裁判决定把比赛推迟到下个周末。图中可辨识场景：积水的球场、举着喇叭的裁判、围在边线旁的两队教练。

pos.zh: 推迟；延期；暂缓；使居次位

derivatives.zh: 由 postpone 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「延期；推迟」
由 postpone 加 -ed 构成的过去分词作定语，义为「被推迟的」

senses.title: To move an event to a later time
senses.definition: to arrange for an event, appointment or journey to take place later than was planned
senses.definitionCN: 把活动、约会或行程安排在比原计划更晚的时间
senses.example: They postponed the wedding until the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把婚礼推迟到春天举行。
senses.why: The Latin verb postponere is built from post, after, and ponere, to place, so the event is literally put further back on the calendar.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词 postponere 由 post（在后）与 ponere（放置）组成，事情就是被「放到日历更靠后的位置」上，所以是改期。

senses.title: To leave a decision or action for later
senses.definition: to delay dealing with a decision or action without abandoning it
senses.definitionCN: 暂不处理某个决定或行动，但并没有放弃它
senses.example: The committee postponed its verdict on the disputed plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会暂缓就那份有争议的方案作出裁决。
senses.why: Ponere only says where a thing is put, so the verb can put a decision aside just as easily as it puts a date back, and either way the matter stays open.
senses.whyCN: ponere 只交代「把东西放在哪儿」，所以这个动词能把决定搁到一边，也能把日期往后挪，两种做法都让事情悬着。

senses.title: To place something after another in rank
senses.definition: to treat one thing as less urgent or less important than another and let it come second
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事的紧迫性或重要性低于另一事，让它排在后面
senses.example: He postponed his own career so that his brother could study abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 他把自己事业的事往后放，好让弟弟出国读书。
senses.why: The spatial picture turns abstract: priority is also a line with things placed along it, and whatever is put behind has to wait its turn.
senses.whyCN: 这个空间画面转向抽象：优先次序同样是一条排队线，被放到后面的东西就得等轮到自己。

senses.title: To slow a process so that it happens later
senses.definition: to hold back a natural or gradual process so that its results appear at a later stage
senses.definitionCN: 使自然的或渐进的过程放慢，让结果出现得更晚
senses.example: Early treatment can postpone the worst effects of the disease.
senses.exampleCN: 早期治疗可以延缓这种疾病最严重的影响。
senses.why: If a single event can be placed later on a calendar, a process with an expected end can be pushed back in the same way, and that is how the verb reaches illness and ageing.
senses.whyCN: 既然一件事能在日程上往后放，一个有预期终点的过程也能照样往后推，动词于是走进了疾病与衰老这类话题。

intro.en: Postpone is Latin postponere carried into English almost whole: post meant after and ponere meant to place, so the word has always been about putting something further back.
intro.cn: postpone 几乎原样搬自拉丁语 postponere：post 意为「在后」，ponere 意为「放置」，所以这个词从头到尾说的都是把东西往后放。

items.en: Ponere meant to put, set or place, and it built a large family of English words about position and arrangement.
items.cn: ponere 意为放置、安放，它造出了一大批表示位置与排列的英语词。

items.en: The prefix post meant after or behind, whether the distance was measured in space or in time.
items.cn: 前缀 post 意为「在后」，既可量空间，也可量时间。

items.en: Postponere joined the two: to put one thing after another, and in later usage to put an affair off to a later date.
items.cn: postponere 把两者合起来：把一物放到另一物之后，后来也指把事情挪到更晚的日子。

items.en: English borrowed the verb in the sixteenth century, first for placing things in order, then for shifting dates and plans.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入这个动词，先用于按次序摆放，随后用于改动日期与计划。

items.en: Modern English uses it mainly for dates, decisions and processes, while the older ranking sense survives in formal writing.
items.cn: 现代英语主要用它谈日期、决定与过程，较早的「排序」义则留在正式书面语里。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words built on the Latin verb ponere; the near-meaning group collects verbs for moving something to a later time.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁动词 ponere 构成的词；近义组收表示把事情挪到更晚时间的动词。

entries.definition: The act of moving an event or decision to a later time.
entries.definitionCN: 把活动或决定改到更晚时间的做法；延期。

entries.definition: One of the parts that a larger whole is put together from.
entries.definitionCN: 组成整体的部件之一；成分。

entries.definition: A person who is placed against another in a contest.
entries.definitionCN: 在竞赛中被放到对手位置上的人；对手。

entries.definition: The place where someone or something has been put.
entries.definitionCN: 人或物被放置的地方；位置。

entries.definition: To make something happen later than planned.
entries.definitionCN: 使某事比计划更晚发生；延迟。

entries.definition: To put off an action until a later time, often officially.
entries.definitionCN: 把行动正式推迟到以后。

entries.definition: To change an arranged time to a later one.
entries.definitionCN: 把约定的时间往后改；推迟。

entries.definition: To decide not to continue with a plan for now.
entries.definitionCN: 决定暂时不推进某项计划；搁置。

normalIntro.en: The word is a Latin verb of placing, and every sense is a different place on a line: a calendar, a queue of priorities, a process running late.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语里表示「放置」的动词，每个义项都是同一条线上的不同位置：日历、优先次序的队列、走慢了的过程。

normal.en: Post- means after and ponere means place, so postpone is simply to place after.
normal.cn: post- 意为「在后」，ponere 意为「放置」，postpone 就是「放到后面」。

normal.en: The family shares ponere: component is put together, opponent is put against you, position is where a thing is put.
normal.cn: 这一族词共用 ponere：component 是被拼在一起，opponent 是被放到你对面，position 是被放置的地方。

normal.en: A postponed match has a new date; a postponed decision has no date at all, only a later one.
normal.cn: postponed 的比赛有新日期；被搁置的决定根本没有日期，只有「以后」。

normal.en: The noun is postponement, and it takes -ment like movement and agreement.
normal.cn: 名词形式是 postponement，和 movement、agreement 一样加 -ment。

normal.en: Formal writing still says that one aim is postponed to another, meaning placed below it.
normal.cn: 正式书面语里还会说某个目标被 postponed to 另一个目标，意思是排在它之下。

abstract.en: To postpone is to move a thing down a line without taking it off the line.
abstract.cn: 推迟是把一样东西在队伍里往后挪，而不是把它从队伍里拿掉。

abstract.en: A calendar is a row of places, and the word treats time as something you can rearrange.
abstract.cn: 日历是一排位置，这个词把时间当成可以重新摆放的东西。

abstract.en: What is put behind still exists; that is why postponement is not cancellation.
abstract.cn: 被放到后面的东西依然存在，所以延期并不等于取消。

examples.en: They postponed the wedding until the spring.
examples.cn: 他们把婚礼推迟到春天举行。

examples.en: The judge postponed the hearing for two weeks.
examples.cn: 法官把听证会推迟了两周。

examples.en: Nothing was cancelled; every item on the list was simply postponed.
examples.cn: 什么都没取消，清单上每一项只是被往后推了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「怕事拖」——越怕事情办不成，越往后拖；postpone 就是推迟、延期。

root: 拉丁语 post-（在后）+ ponere（放置）→ postponere（放到后面）→ 英语 postpone；同族有 component、opponent、position。

sensesIntro.en: One image of placing runs through the senses: a date moved back, a decision left pending, a task pushed down the queue, a process slowed.
sensesIntro.cn: 几个义项贯穿着同一个「放置」的画面：日期后移、决定悬着、任务排到后面、过程放慢。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a date on a luggage tag scraped off and written again, later than before.
core.cn: 核心意象：行李牌上的日期被刮掉，重新写上一个更晚的日子。

branches.en: a stadium filling with rain while the referee talks to both coaches
branches.cn: 球场积起雨水，裁判与两位教练商量

branches.en: a verdict left unsigned on the committee table
branches.cn: 委员会桌上那份没有签字的裁决

branches.en: one career set down so another can go forward
branches.cn: 一份事业被放下，好让另一份往前走

branches.en: a doctor describing how treatment buys time
branches.cn: 医生说明治疗如何争取时间

branches.en: a date and a disease both pushed back
branches.cn: 一个日期与一种病都被往后推

intro.en: A Latin prefix of delay and a Latin verb of placing carry the word; English then adds -ment for the act and -ed for the result.
intro.cn: 一个表示「在后」的拉丁前缀和一个表示「放置」的拉丁动词撑起这个词，英语再用 -ment 表示行为、用 -ed 表示结果。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

items.meaning: to put off to a later time

definition_en: to ask for information, or to look into a matter carefully
core_image: 有人站在服务台前，身子前倾，开口问第一个问题
scene: 车站服务窗口前围了几个人，其中一个把护照推到玻璃下。 She stopped to inquire about the time of the last train.
sceneCN: 这里 inquire 是「询问、打听」（第 1 个义项：为获取信息而发问），句意是她停下来打听末班火车的时间。画面里能看到的物件：护照、时刻表、服务窗口。

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「询问；调查」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「询问者」
由现在分词转作形容词，义为「爱刨根问底的」
同词根的形容词，义为「好奇的；爱打听的」

senses.title: To ask for information
senses.definition: to ask someone for facts, news, or details that you need
senses.definitionCN: 向某人询问你所需要的消息、新闻或细节
senses.example: A young man inquired whether the museum was open on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 一位年轻人询问博物馆周一是否开门。
senses.why: Latin quaerere means to seek; in- plus quaerere is "to seek into", and the first step of seeking is asking.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 quaerere 意为「寻求」；in- 加 quaerere 就是「向内寻求」，而寻求的第一步就是发问。

senses.title: To look into a matter
senses.definition: to examine an accident, a complaint, or a crime in order to find the truth
senses.definitionCN: 为查明真相而审查事故、投诉或罪行
senses.example: The council will inquire into why the bridge was not repaired.
senses.exampleCN: 议会将调查这座桥为何一直没有修好。
senses.why: The "into" is literal here: the seeker goes inside the facts rather than staying at the counter.
senses.whyCN: 这里的「向内」是字面的：寻求者走进了事实内部，而不是停在柜台前。

senses.title: To ask about someone's health
senses.definition: to ask politely how someone is, especially someone who has been ill
senses.definitionCN: 礼貌地询问某人近况，尤指曾生病的人
senses.example: My mother phoned to inquire after your father.
senses.exampleCN: 我母亲打电话来问令尊的近况。
senses.why: The fixed phrase inquire after keeps an old use of after meaning "concerning" or "on the subject of".
senses.whyCN: 固定搭配 inquire after 保留了 after 表示「关于」的旧用法。

intro.en: Inquire comes from Latin inquirere "to seek into", and shares its root with question and require.
intro.cn: inquire 来自拉丁语 inquirere「向里寻求」，与 question、require 同根。

items.en: Quaerere "to seek, search for" was a common Latin verb of hunting and asking.
items.cn: quaerere「寻求、寻找」是拉丁语中用于打猎与发问的常用动词。

items.en: In- plus quaerere gave inquirere, "to search into, investigate".
items.cn: in- 加 quaerere 得到 inquirere，意为「向内搜寻、调查」。

items.en: The early spelling with an e, inquerere, is also recorded and explains the English -e- of inquire.
items.cn: 较早的拼写 inquerere 也有记载，这解释了英语 inquire 中的 e。

items.en: Old French enquerre passed the verb into Middle English as enqueren.
items.cn: 古法语 enquerre 把动词传入中古英语，作 enqueren。

items.en: The Latin-style spelling inquire was restored in the sixteenth century; inquire and enquire are both current.
items.cn: 十六世纪恢复了拉丁式拼写 inquire；inquire 与 enquire 现今并存。

note.en: The look-alike group shares Latin quaerere; the near-meaning group holds other verbs of asking.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语 quaerere；近义组收其他表示「问」的动词。

entries.definition: To need or demand something, with re- "back" on the same root.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「需要、要求」，前缀 re- 表「回」，词根相同。

entries.definition: A sentence that asks something, from the same seeking root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「问题」，词根同为「寻求」。

entries.definition: The British spelling of the same verb; inquire is the usual form in American English.
entries.definitionCN: 同一动词的英式拼写；美式英语多用 inquire。

entries.definition: The everyday general verb, neutral in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「问」，最日常、语气中性。

entries.definition: To examine facts formally, like inquire into but stronger.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「调查」，比 inquire into 更正式、更重。

entries.definition: To raise a doubt or ask a question, common in computing.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「质疑、查询」，常见于计算机语境。

normalIntro.en: These hooks work with the seeking root quaer- and the preposition each phrase takes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子利用「寻求」词根 quaer-，以及各搭配所带的介词。

normal.en: quaer- is to seek; inquire about means seeking news about something.
normal.cn: quaer- 是「寻求」；inquire about 就是寻求关于某事的信息。

normal.en: inquire into is deeper: you go into the facts.
normal.cn: inquire into 更深一层：走进事实内部。

normal.en: Same root as question and require.
normal.cn: 与 question、require 同根。

normal.en: Inquire at the desk is what a polite traveller says.
normal.cn: 礼貌的旅客会说在服务台 inquiries。

normal.en: Enquire and inquire are the same word in two spellings.
normal.cn: enquire 与 inquire 是同一个词的两种拼写。

abstract.en: Picture leaning forward over a counter: asking is stepping towards the answer.
abstract.cn: 想象前倾身子靠向柜台：发问就是朝答案迈一步。

abstract.en: Every inquiry is a small hunt with words as dogs.
abstract.cn: 每次询问都是一场小猎，词就是猎狗。

abstract.en: To inquire after someone is to seek not facts but their well-being.
abstract.cn: inquire after 某人求的不是事实，而是他的安康。

examples.en: Please inquire at the front desk for your key.
examples.cn: 请到前台询问钥匙的事。

examples.en: They inquired into the cause of the fire.
examples.cn: 他们调查了火灾的原因。

examples.en: He telephoned to inquire about the job.
examples.cn: 他打电话来打听那份工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因快问」——因为想快，就得赶快问

root: 拉丁语 quaerere「寻求」→ in- + quaerere = inquirere「向里寻求、调查」→ 古法语 enquerre → 中古英语 enqueren。词根 quaer-/quest- 也见于 question、require、request、inquiry。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: asking for facts, investigating a matter, and asking after a person's health.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：打听事实、调查某事，以及问候某人的近况。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person leans over a counter and asks the first question.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人俯身靠在柜台前，问出第一个问题。

branches.en: THE COUNTER: asking for times, prices or directions.
branches.cn: 柜台这条线：问时间、问价钱、问路。

branches.en: THE FILE: inquiry into an accident or complaint.
branches.cn: 卷宗这条线：对事故或投诉的调查。

branches.en: THE PHONE CALL: inquiring after a sick friend.
branches.cn: 电话这条线：问候生病的朋友。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses begin with seeking; only the depth changes.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都从「寻求」开始，只是深浅不同。

branches.en: THE TEMPO: the investigating sense is slower and more formal.
branches.cn: 节奏线：「调查」义更慢、更正式。

intro.en: Inquire is in- "into" plus the Latin root quaer- "seek", with a French spelling layer over it.
intro.cn: inquire 是前缀 in-「向内」加拉丁词根 quaer-「寻求」，上面又叠了一层法语拼写。

latinIntro.en: Latin quaerere, inquirere and the noun inquisitio are attested; the variant inquerere explains the English e.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quaerere、inquirere 及名词 inquisitio 均有记载，异体 inquerere 解释了英语的 e。

items.example: It turns seeking into seeking inwards.
items.exampleCN: 它把「寻求」变成「向内寻求」。

items.example: The root runs through question and require.
items.exampleCN: 这一词根贯穿 question 与 require。

items.example: The compound is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合动词是直接来源。

items.example: Inquiry names the asking or the investigation.
A sister word from the same root.
The prefix re- changes the direction.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 改变了方向。

items.example: The -ive form keeps the same root.
items.exampleCN: 带 -ive 的形式保留同一词根。

definition_en: a reduction in price, to reduce a price, or to treat something as unlikely
core_image: 价签上原来的数字被划掉，旁边用红笔写了一个更小的数
scene: 收银台前排着队，店员把标价牌翻过来，背面写着另一个数字。 The shop gave students a ten per cent discount.
sceneCN: 这里 discount 指「折扣」（第 1 个义项：从原价减去的部分）；句意是这家店给学生打九折。

collocations.phrase: a discount of ten per cent

senses.title: An amount taken off a price
senses.definition: a sum by which a price is lowered
senses.definitionCN: 从原价里减掉的那一部分钱
senses.example: The shop gave students a ten per cent discount.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店给学生打九折。
senses.why: The same object asks for less because of who is buying.
senses.whyCN: 同样的东西，因为买的人不同，就要得少一些。

senses.title: To lower a price
senses.definition: to sell something at a lower price than usual
senses.definitionCN: 以低于平常的价格出售
senses.example: The old stock was discounted by half.
senses.exampleCN: 旧货打了对折。
senses.why: A number is crossed out so that a smaller one can speak.
senses.whyCN: 划掉一个数字，好让更小的那个说话。

senses.title: To treat something as unlikely
senses.definition: to decide that a story or a risk need not be taken seriously
senses.definitionCN: 认为某个说法或风险不必当真
senses.example: We should not discount the risk of delay.
senses.exampleCN: 我们不该轻视延误的风险。
senses.why: The mind also crosses out what it does not wish to count.
senses.whyCN: 脑子也会划掉它不愿计入的东西。

intro.en: Discount came from dis- plus count, literally to count off a part, and passed through Italian and French.
intro.cn: discount 是 dis- 加 count，字面是「扣掉一部分再算」，经意大利语与法语传来。

items.en: Computare meant to reckon together, the base of count.
items.cn: computare 指合起来计算，是 count 的词源。

items.en: Disconto named a sum counted off from a debt.
items.cn: disconto 指从欠款里扣掉的数目。

items.en: Descompte carried the money sense into French trade.
items.cn: descompte 把这个钱的用法带进法国商业。

items.en: Discount named money taken off a price.
items.cn: discount 指从价钱里减去的钱。

items.en: The verb widened to mean treating an idea as not worth counting.
items.cn: 动词义后来扩展到「不把某个说法算进去」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the count stem, while the meaning group names other price cuts.
note.cn: 形近组共用 count 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他减价说法。

entries.definition: to say numbers in order or to include something
entries.definitionCN: 按顺序数数，或把某物算进去

entries.definition: a record of money kept at a bank
entries.definitionCN: 银行里的存款记录

entries.definition: able to be counted one by one
entries.definitionCN: 可以逐个计数的

entries.definition: a lowering of price or amount
entries.definitionCN: 价格或数量的降低

entries.definition: money returned after a payment
entries.definitionCN: 付款后退回的一部分钱

entries.definition: an amount taken away from a total
entries.definitionCN: 从总数中扣除的数额

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a crossed-out price to a risk that is quietly left out of the count.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从被划掉的价格，走到被悄悄排除在计算之外的风险。

normal.en: Dis- plus count: count a little less.
normal.cn: dis- 加 count：少算一点。

normal.en: A discount is a number crossed out with a smile.
normal.cn: 折扣就是一个被笑着划掉的数字。

normal.en: Student discount asks who you are before what you buy.
normal.cn: 学生优惠先问你是谁，再问你买什么。

normal.en: To discount a warning is to leave it out of the sum.
normal.cn: 轻视一个警告，就是把它从总数里漏掉。

normal.en: The same word lowers a price and lowers a risk.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既压低价钱，也压低风险的分量。

abstract.en: Picture a red line through an old price.
abstract.cn: 想象旧价钱上划过一道红线。

abstract.en: Picture a smaller number written in the corner.
abstract.cn: 想象角落里写着一个更小的数。

abstract.en: Picture a warning note moved to the bottom of a pile.
abstract.cn: 想象一张警告纸条被挪到一摞纸的最下面。

examples.en: The shop gave students a ten per cent discount.
examples.cn: 这家店给学生打九折。

examples.en: The old stock was discounted by half.
examples.cn: 旧货打了对折。

examples.en: We should not discount the risk of delay.
examples.cn: 我们不该轻视延误的风险。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 discount 记成「的士扛」：的士费太贵，扛着东西走，店家只好给个折扣。

root: 由 dis-（去掉）加 count（计算）构成，字面意思是「扣掉一部分再算」。这个词经意大利语 disconto 与法语 descompte 进入英语，先指从欠款或价钱里减去的数目，后来也作动词表示打折，并引申为把某种说法或风险排除在考虑之外。

sensesIntro.en: From money taken off a price, to the act of lowering it, to a risk left out of the count.
sensesIntro.cn: 从价钱里减掉的钱，到把价钱压低这个动作，再到被排除在计算之外的风险。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old price crossed out, a smaller number beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧价钱被划掉，旁边写着一个更小的数。

chain: PART OF IT IS STRUCK OUT

branches.en: The first sense is the sum taken off the price.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是从价钱里减掉的那笔钱。

branches.en: The second sense is the act of lowering the price.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把价钱压低的动作。

branches.en: The third sense is a claim left out of the count.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是被排除在计算之外的说法。

branches.en: The amount and the act both make the number smaller.
branches.cn: 金额与动作，都让那个数字变小。

branches.en: A price and a risk can both be counted for less.
branches.cn: 价钱和风险，都可以被算得更轻。

intro.en: Discount belongs to the count family, words about reckoning and accounts.
intro.cn: discount 属于 count 一族，围绕计算与账目。

latinIntro.en: Latin computare, to reckon together, gives count, account and discount.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 computare（合起来计算）给出 count、account 与 discount。

items.example: The discount brought the price down.

items.meaning: to reckon numbers or include something

items.meaning: a record of money or an explanation

definition_zh: 仓库；货栈；把（货物）存入仓库；大型仓储式商店
definition_en: a large building where goods are stored, or to place goods in such a building
core_image: 一栋没有橱窗的大房子，里面只有货架、托盘与叉车，货进来后等着再出去
scene: 叉车把托盘推进高大的货架深处，卷帘门在身后落下，这些货要等到下一批订单才会被取出。 The warehouse holds the pallets until the shops place their orders.
sceneCN: 卷帘门在叉车后落下，整托货物被推进高架深处，等待着下一批订单；句中的 warehouse 指「存放货物、等待再运出的大建筑」（第 1 个义项：以储藏为主要功能的建筑）。图中可辨识物件：叉车、托盘、高货架、卷帘门。

senses.title: A building for storing goods
senses.titleCN: 存放货物、等待再运出的大建筑
senses.definition: a large building in which goods are kept until they are sold or moved on
senses.definitionCN: 货物在售出或转运之前被存放其中的大型建筑
senses.example: The warehouse holds the pallets until the shops place their orders.
senses.exampleCN: 仓库持有这些托盘，直到店铺下单为止。
senses.why: the compound joins the old word for goods with the word for a house, so the name says exactly what the building is for.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把指货物的旧词与指房屋的词拼在一起，名称直接说明了建筑的用途。

senses.title: To store goods in such a building
senses.definition: to place goods in a warehouse for keeping
senses.definitionCN: 把货物放入仓库保存
senses.example: The grain was warehoused until prices improved.
senses.exampleCN: 谷物被存入仓库，等价格好转再出。
senses.why: the building's name became a verb for putting things into it, a common shift in English.
senses.whyCN: 建筑的名称变成了「把东西放进去」的动词，这在英语中很常见。

senses.title: A large no-frills shop
senses.titleCN: 以仓储式陈列经营的大型商店
senses.definition: a large shop that displays goods on pallets in a plain building, often selling to members
senses.definitionCN: 在朴素建筑里以托盘方式陈列货物、常面向会员销售的大型商店
senses.example: The warehouse club sells flour by the fifty-kilo sack.
senses.exampleCN: 仓储式会员店按五十公斤一袋卖面粉。
senses.why: the shop borrows the building's look: goods sit on pallets, the room is plain, and the price is low.
senses.whyCN: 这种商店借用了仓库的样子：货放在托盘上，空间朴素，价格低廉。

senses.title: The dispatch end of online selling
senses.titleCN: 网络零售的配送仓储中心
senses.definition: a centre where goods are stored and packed for delivery to individual customers
senses.definitionCN: 存放货物并打包、直接送往个人顾客的中心
senses.example: The online seller runs one warehouse for the whole country.
senses.exampleCN: 这家网商在全国只用一个仓储中心。
senses.why: when the shop moves online, the warehouse takes over the packing that the shop counter once did.
senses.whyCN: 商店搬到网上后，原本由柜台完成的打包工作转由仓库承担。

senses.title: A customs-controlled store
senses.titleCN: 受海关监管、关税暂缓的保税仓库
senses.definition: a secured store where imported goods may be held before duty is paid
senses.definitionCN: 进口货物在缴纳关税前可存放其中的受监管仓库
senses.example: The wine stayed in a bonded warehouse for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 这批葡萄酒在保税仓库里放了两年。
senses.why: the state needs a place where goods are physically present but not yet legally imported, and calls it a warehouse.
senses.whyCN: 国家需要一个地方，让货物实际在场但在法律上尚未进口，于是称之为仓库。

senses.title: A store of data in computing
senses.titleCN: 计算机系统中的数据仓库
senses.definition: a central store that holds data gathered from many systems for analysis
senses.definitionCN: 汇集来自多个系统的数据、供分析之用的中央存储
senses.example: The data warehouse pulls figures from every branch.
senses.exampleCN: 数据仓库从每个分支机构抽取数据。
senses.why: computing reuses the building: data is stacked and kept, then drawn out when needed.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域复用了这座建筑：数据被堆起来保存，需要时再取出。

senses.title: Storage as a business
senses.titleCN: 作为行业的仓储与仓储设施
senses.definition: the business of storing goods for others, or the space used for it
senses.definitionCN: 替他人存放货物的行业，或用于此事的空间
senses.example: Warehousing near the port is cheaper than inland.
senses.exampleCN: 港口附近的仓储比内陆便宜。
senses.why: once storage is sold as a service, the building's name extends to the trade and to the space itself.
senses.whyCN: 当储存作为服务出售时，建筑名就扩展到整个行业以及所占的空间。

senses.title: A store of memories or records
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：存放记忆或资料的储藏处
senses.definition: a place or system that keeps large amounts of memories, records or material
senses.definitionCN: 保存大量记忆、记录或材料的场所或系统
senses.example: The archive is a warehouse of the city's ordinary voices.
senses.exampleCN: 这座档案馆存放着这座城市普通人的声音。
senses.why: the physical image survives without walls: whatever is kept in quantity can be called a warehouse.
senses.whyCN: 实体意象在没有墙壁时仍然成立：任何被大量保存的东西都可以叫仓库。

intro.en: Warehouse is a native English compound of ware 'goods' and house, both inherited from Old English. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: warehouse 是英语本族复合词，由 ware「货物」与 house「房屋」构成，两者都承自古代英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Waru meant 'goods, articles of merchandise, a kept thing', and its descendant ware survives in wares and in compounds.
items.cn: waru 意为「货物、商品、被保存之物」，其后代 ware 仍存于「货品」及若干复合词中。

items.en: Hūs meant 'house, dwelling, shelter', the direct ancestor of house.
items.cn: hūs 意为「房屋、住所、遮蔽处」，是 house 的直接祖先。

items.en: Ware plus house named a building where goods were kept, and the word is recorded from the medieval period.
items.cn: 「货物」加「房屋」指存放货物的建筑，这个词在中世纪已有记载。

items.en: With overseas trade the warehouse became a port institution, with receipts, customs control and bonded storage.
items.cn: 随着海外贸易，仓库成为港口制度的一部分，出现仓单、海关监管与保税存放。

items.en: The twentieth century added the warehouse club and the distribution centre, and computing added the data warehouse.
items.cn: 二十世纪添了仓储式会员店与配送中心，计算机领域又添了数据仓库。

note.en: Group one holds words built from the same two halves or their near kin; group two holds names for places that store things.
note.cn: 第一组由同样的两半或其近亲构成；第二组是存放物品的场所之名。

entries.definition: An old word for manufactured goods or articles for sale, still heard in wares and earthenware.
entries.definitionCN: 指制成品或待售物品的旧词，仍见于「货品」与「陶器」等说法。

entries.definition: The ordinary word for a dwelling or building; in the compound it simply supplies the building.
entries.definitionCN: 指住所或建筑的常用词；在复合词里只提供「建筑」这一层。

entries.definition: The business or process of storing goods; the longer form names the activity, not the building.
entries.definitionCN: 存放货物的业务或过程；较长的形式指活动，而非建筑。

entries.definition: A worker who handles goods in a warehouse; the compound plus a person suffix names the job.
entries.definitionCN: 在仓库中搬运货物的人；复合词加表人后缀构成职业名。

entries.definition: A place where vehicles are kept or goods are received for transport; it stresses movement rather than storage.
entries.definitionCN: 停放车辆或接收待运货物之处；强调运输而非储存。

entries.definition: A building for storing things, close in meaning but without the commercial and customs associations.
entries.definitionCN: 存放物品的建筑，意思接近，但不带商业与海关的联想。

entries.definition: The room at the back of a shop where reserve stock is kept; much smaller than a warehouse.
entries.definitionCN: 商店后面存放备用存货的房间，比仓库小得多。

entries.definition: A large facility that sorts and sends goods onward; storage is a means, not the purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 对货物进行分拣并继续发运的大型设施；储存只是手段而非目的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the two real halves, the real modern formats and the real customs phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的两半、真实的现代业态与真实的海关说法。

normal.en: Ware plus house: a house for goods, not for people.
normal.cn: 「货物」加「房屋」：给货住的房子，不是给人住的。

normal.en: The family runs warehouse, warehousing, warehoused and warehouseman.
normal.cn: 同族词包括仓库、仓储、已入库的与仓库工人。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: bonded warehouse, warehouse club, data warehouse.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出这个词：保税仓库、仓储式会员店、数据仓库。

normal.en: A warehouse has no shop window; its whole purpose is to keep things out of view.
normal.cn: 仓库没有橱窗；它的全部用途就是把东西放在看不见的地方。

normal.en: Online selling turned the warehouse into the busiest part of the shop.
normal.cn: 网络销售把仓库变成了店铺里最忙碌的部分。

abstract.en: Picture a building with no windows and a door that only opens for trucks.
abstract.cn: 想象一栋没有窗、门只为货车而开的建筑。

abstract.en: Picture shelves that hold seasons of goods in silence.
abstract.cn: 想象一排排货架，静默地囤着好几个季节的货。

abstract.en: Picture a mind that stacks memories on pallets and fetches them years later.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗心把记忆码在托盘上，多年后再取出来。

examples.en: The warehouse is full, so new stock waits on the trucks.
examples.cn: 仓库已满，新货只能在车上等着。

examples.en: Goods in a bonded warehouse are stored before duty is paid.
examples.cn: 保税仓库中的货物在缴税前存放。

examples.en: The company warehoused the surplus rather than discount it.
examples.cn: 公司把余货入库，而不是打折卖掉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ware（货物）+ house（房子）」——放货物的房子 → 仓库

root: 英语本族复合词：ware（货物，古英语 waru）＋house（房屋，古英语 hūs），字面即「放货的房子」，与拉丁语无同族关系。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with a plain building for goods and then follow the same shape into shops, delivery centres, customs control, computing and finally into any store of kept things.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一座放货的朴素建筑开始，再让同一形状走进商店、配送中心、海关监管、计算机，最后成为任何储藏之所。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a windowless building where pallets wait behind a rolling door.
core.cn: 核心意象：一栋没有窗的建筑，托盘在卷帘门后等待。

branches.en: THE BUILDING AND THE TRADE: storage is first a place, then a service sold by the square metre.
branches.cn: 建筑与行业：储存先是一个场所，后来成为按面积出售的服务。

branches.en: PUT IN AND SEND OUT: the verb and the delivery centre are the two directions of the same door.
branches.cn: 放入与发出：动词与配送中心是同一扇门的两个方向。

branches.en: THE LOOK BECOMES A SHOP: pallets and plain aisles are turned into a retail format.
branches.cn: 样子变成商店：托盘与朴素通道被改造成一种零售业态。

branches.en: HELD BY LAW: goods may sit physically present yet not legally entered.
branches.cn: 受法律扣留：货物可以实际在场，却在法律上尚未入境。

branches.en: NO WALLS NEEDED: data and memories are stacked and fetched in exactly the same shape.
branches.cn: 无需墙壁：数据与记忆以完全相同的形状被堆放和取出。

intro.en: The word is two Old English nouns joined, so there is no Latin affix to read.
intro.cn: 这个词由两个古英语名词并合而成，因此没有拉丁词缀可拆。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entries apply: both halves are inherited Germanic words.
latinIntro.cn: 不适用拉丁条目：两半都是承继的日耳曼语词。

scene: 选举前最后一周，志愿者挨家敲门。 They ran a campaign to save the library.

senses.title: An organized drive for a goal
senses.definition: a planned set of actions aimed at changing something
senses.definitionCN: 为改变某事而策划的一系列行动
senses.example: They ran a campaign to save the library.
senses.exampleCN: 他们发起了一场拯救图书馆的运动。
senses.why: The core image is a group marching with banners through streets.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一群人举着标语在街上游行。

senses.title: A series of military operations
senses.definition: a connected series of battles fought for one aim
senses.definitionCN: 为同一目标进行的一系列战斗
senses.example: The winter campaign ended in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季战役在群山中结束。
senses.why: The word first named armies taking the field for a season.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早指军队开赴野外作战的一个季节。

senses.title: To work for a cause or office
senses.definition: to take part in a planned effort to win support or votes
senses.definitionCN: 参与争取支持或选票的有计划行动
senses.example: She campaigned for a seat on the council.
senses.exampleCN: 她为争取议会席位参加竞选。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for taking part in such an effort.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，指参与这类行动。
